WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  INNER JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
bucket_shares AS (
  SELECT bucket_count,
         1.0 * bucket_count / SUM(bucket_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT bucket_count,
         share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM bucket_shares
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(bucket_count), 0) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_share) AS average_amount_above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
